title: The Bottle That Crossed the Sea

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".
collection.description: A clear bottle made of a light, bendable material washes ashore, and the village wonders where it began its journey.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A clear bottle made of a light, bendable material washes ashore, and the village wonders where it began its journey.

choices.label: Decide What to Do with It.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: A scholar imagines someone far away drinking from it, perhaps on a hot day just like this one.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A skeptic says it might have drifted for years and its maker may be long gone.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The children trace imaginary routes across a sand map.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A fisher says the currents could have carried it from anywhere, and the map gets very large.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: An elder says it does not belong on the beach and sets it aside with the other strange things the tide brings, labeled "origin unknown."

c1__fx.name: Outcome C1
c1__fx.text: The village uses it as a float for a fishing net.

c1__text.name: Outcome C1
c1__text.text: The village uses it as a float for a fishing net.
